posts.action: 用包含冲突、插队和依赖关系的追加指令测试是否仍能保持顺序与目标一致。
posts.risk: 版本和产品语境未在离线文本中完整说明，结论来自单个用户体验。
posts.textPreview: Queue was the way but with 5.5 the model doesn’t get confused anymore, you can just throw stuff at it while it works and it will diligently process whatever you throw at it.
